messages:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: High error rate and 95th pct latency spike for /v1/generate on prod-us-east-1. Impact: some requests returning truncated tokens and 503s. See alert: https://alerts.internal/INC-2026-042

incident-bot: Summary: 12:34 UTC started rising. Current error rate 7.4% (baseline 0.2%). Avg latency 1.8s -> 4.5s. Affected model: rw-7b-quant-v2 (serving group: inference-pool-gpu-a).

sophie: acked. jumping in. oncall handoff incoming in 10m. @ravi @keisha fyi. :eyes:

sophie: first quick mitigation: disabling KV cache for rw-7b-quant-v2 on pool gpu-a to validate the hypothesis that stale/invalid KV entries + batching is causing token corruption and tail latency. issuing command now:

sophie: ```
# disable kv cache on pool
redwoodctl apply --pool inference-pool-gpu-a --model rw-7b-quant-v2 --set runtime.kv_cache.enabled=false
```

sophie: rolling to 50% of the nodes, watch for error rate drop.

ravi: on it. watching logs. grabbing a tail.

ravi: tail logs show a pattern: a spike of E_INVALID_KV_ENTRY in the same time window as a config rollout that bumped batch_size from 16 -> 32 for a short-lived autoscale test. snippet:

ravi: ```
2026-03-15T12:34:22Z ERROR inference-runtime kv_cache.go:142 E_INVALID_KV_ENTRY key=0x9f a.len=0
2026-03-15T12:34:22Z WARN batching batch_scheduler.go:78 dropped batch (size=32) latency=4600ms
```

daniel: interesting — the quantization patch landed yesterday to reduce memory (int8 path). Could be a regression where the quantized KV layout doesn't match the runtime expectation under larger batches.

keisha: rolling back batch_size to 16 on gpu-a for rw-7b-quant-v2 now as a soft mitigation. If disabling KV cache helps, we'll have two mitigations in flight.

marta: customer-impact note: CS reports two customers seeing streaming truncation and one support ticket flagged as high. I told them we have an active incident and working a mitigation. Will follow up with a status note after we stabilize.

sophie: update after KV cache disable: error rate down to 1.1%, latency p95 at 2.0s. Seems KV cache was amplifying a bug. keeping it disabled while we investigate. :white_check_mark:

ravi: confirming logs: E_INVALID_KV_ENTRY occurrences dropped to near zero after kv cache disabled. batching rollback also reduced dropped batches. both likely contributors.

daniel: root cause hypothesis: quantized model variant changed the internal KV serialization layout. Under larger batching path (batch_size=32) we saw race where stale/invalid KV pointers were read, returning zero-len entries causing token corruption and backend retries -> 503s. reproducer plan needed.

sophie: next steps agreed: 1) keep KV cache off on rw-7b-quant-v2 in gpu-a and gpu-b; 2) revert yesterday's quantization patch for rw-7b-quant-v2 to a safe canary; 3) run a synthetic load test to reproduce. we'll schedule a postmortem after stable.

ravi: creating ticket INC-2026-042-RT for tracking, linking logs and the reproducer plan. assigning owners below.

sophie: handoff to @ravi for deep debug. i'll stay in channel until postmortem scheduled. @keisha please prepare the rollback PR for quantization and coordinate with eng-runtime CI for canary rollout.

keisha: on it — PR drafted and running integration tests. ETA ~90m. will post link here.

marta: CS: drafting a short customer-facing blurb for impacted customers. will send for approval once we confirm no regression after kv disable.

sophie: incident status: mitigated -> partial (reduction in error rate but KV cache disabled is temporary). moving to follow-up actions and postmortem scheduling.

sophie: scheduling postmortem: propose 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC (document: https://docs.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-042). please confirm availability.

ravi: confirmed. I'll prepare the reproducer and a flamegraph showing the batch hot path.

keisha: confirmed. I'll include the quantization PR diff and CI logs.

marta: confirmed. will include customer timelines and support tickets.

sophie: action items (tracking in INC-2026-042-RT):
- "A1: Repro and root-cause validate" owner: ravi, due: 2026-03-17, acceptance: reproducer that triggers E_INVALID_KV_ENTRY under controlled load.
- "A2: Hotfix rollback quantization" owner: keisha, due: 2026-03-16, acceptance: canary rollout with no errors and KV cache re-enabled safely.
- "A3: Repair KV cache validation/guards" owner: daniel, due: 2026-03-23, acceptance: runtime rejects invalid KV entries and logs a metric kv_cache.validation.failures.
- "A4: Add batch-size safety limits for quantized variants" owner: sophie, due: 2026-03-22, acceptance: config guard prevents batch_size > 16 for rw-7b-quant variants unless explicit opt-in.
- "A5: Update runbook and monitoring" owner: marta, due: 2026-03-18, acceptance: runbook includes steps to disable kv cache, rollback batch settings, and customer communication template.

sophie: logging tasks into our tracker and adding owners. will tie PR links into the ticket.

ravi: quick note: until A3 is done we should keep KV cache disabled for quant variants in prod pools as a precaution. going to add a policy rule.

keisha: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/inference/1234 ready, rolling canary in 10m. linking to ticket.

marta: sent first customer notices to impacted accounts with ETA for follow-up. waiting for final confirm to update broad status.

sophie: postmortem agenda draft (to be refined): timeline, impact, root cause, mitigations, action items (owners + acceptance), long-term fixes, test coverage and monitoring improvements, communication.

ravi: additional test suggestion: fuzz the KV serialization/deserialization path with edge-case empty entries and concurrent writes under batching load. will add to A1.

daniel: for A3 let's add unit tests that assert that deserialized KV entries have expected schema and metrics increment on failures. also add a healthcheck for kv_cache that can be polled by monitoring.

sophie: ok team — I'll close the live incident string when canaries are green and KV cache is re-enabled with roll-forward or after rollback PR. For now, keep updates here and link any PRs/tickets. thanks for quick triage. :pray:

incident-bot: Incident state changed: mitigated -> followup. Linked ticket INC-2026-042-RT.

sophie: closing live paging portion of the thread. moving to postmortem notes (keeping this thread open for follow-ups).

ravi: final note before handoff: observed that the batching scheduler metrics did not expose per-model dropped_batch_count; adding that to monitoring will help catch similar regressions earlier. adding as A6.

sophie: A6: owner: ravi, due: 2026-03-21, acceptance: per-model dropped_batch_count exposed to Grafana + alert if rate > 0.5% baseline.

keisha: will post PR updates here when canary completes.

marta: will post final customer communications after postmortem.

sophie: thanks everyone. I'll ping the postmortem invite shortly.
